paras: The ADRO V2 rear diffuser is designed to give the G8X M3 and M4 a cleaner, more aggressive rear-end look while maintaining factory-style fitment.

Made from lightweight prepreg carbon fibre, the V2 diffuser features sharper lines and a more defined shape that highlights the quad exhaust layout and adds depth to the rear of the car. The updated design improves airflow underneath the vehicle and gives the rear a lower, wider appearance without looking overstyled.
ft: ADRO Dry Carbon Fibre Rear Diffuser V2 for BMW M3 G80 G81 / M4 G82 G83 2020+
